draw_hands_on_image: draw hand joints and finger line segments on an image using cv2 circles and lines
project_3d_points: project Nx3 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using a 3x4 camera projection matrix
convert_openpose_to_mano_joints: convert hand joint coordinates from OpenPose format to MANO format with proper finger mapping
load_mano_meshes_from_params: load MANO hand mesh vertices and joints from pose parameters and model dictionaries
refine_mask_with_grabcut: refine noisy segmentation mask edges using OpenCV GrabCut algorithm on a source image
